digest.component_or_area: jira-family sub-seam and datacenter backend adapter
propositions: Jira Data Center requires a shared adapter layer distinct from Cloud to handle REST v2, wiki-markup bodies, PAT auth, and name-based user identity without forking logic or duplicating value maps

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) must stay in place and be parameterized by jira_family contracts rather than relocated, to avoid breaking dynamic loader paths and test mocks
Field/value maps and sanitizers must exist in exactly one implementation in jira_family/ and be imported by both Cloud and DC backends, eliminating the pre-existing three-copy drift

DC backend must reject non-https base_urls unless allow_insecure=true (with warning), never disable certificate verification, and read the PAT from JIRA_PAT environment variable only, not from config files
Rich-text and user-identity variations (ADF vs wiki/plain text, accountId vs name) are expressed as single contracts with per-deployment implementations, not as two separate adapters

The live DC harness running against Jira 8.17.1 must pass end-to-end bidirectional reconciliation (DC issue reaching local store inbound, local edit reaching DC issue outbound) with zero unhandled exceptions
